body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its 3.2-inch high-resolution photo frame with alarm clock 'PFC1' during CES 2009.

With music, movie and photo playback, you can arrange and coordinate a fun and interesting slide show to enjoy over and over again. The easy-to-program alarm clock has a snooze function, calendar and built-in USB to easily add photos.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
